Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. All'interno del nostro business di edifici, il nostro team globale diversificato vi sosterrà attraverso la vostra carriera e vi sfiderà a crescere in modi nuovi ed eccitanti, come trasformiamo l'infrastruttura del mondo. Come Sistemi e Core Assets Product Line Architect, sei responsabile della definizione e dell'evoluzione dell'architettura di sistema per i sistemi di automazione degli edifici. Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? As Systems and Core Assets Product Line Architect , you are responsible for defining and evolving system architecture for building automation systems. You will sharpen the technical vision, defining the strategy for developing common reusable core assets, and evaluating emerging technologies to realize Human-Centric Autonomous Buildings. This role requires operational leadership to deliver high quality and reusable core assets. You will be working with different stakeholders like architects, product managers, project managers and developers. We will be happy to introduce you to our exciting environment! Location : this role will be based in Zug/Switzerland. Please note that qualified candidates need to be legally eligible for work authorization in Switzerland. Your new responsibilities
• Define the architectural runway, technology roadmap, cybersecurity, and ensure total cost of ownership and end-to-end architectural consistency across different products and different R&D sites
• Responsible for identifying, shaping, maintaining and driving the strategy and implementation of Core Assets to be reused by multiple product and system offerings
• Participating in cybersecurity and standardization effort to identify opportunities in the organization where core assets representing such technology should be created, maintained and reused
• Lead diverse and global teams, working with internal and external stakeholders and partners, to create holistic solutions for building automation
• Evaluate organizational and market requirements, recommend cutting-edge technologies, and design products to optimize system performance, simplify workflows and enable business outcomes
• Translate non-functional requirements like scalability, interoperability, and reliability into iterative, risk-based development processes, ensuring alignment with the evolving needs of Autonomous Buildings
• Guide business strategies in HVAC and building automation towards a modular architecture that delivers interoperability across products for seamless operation Your talents and experience
• Bachelor’s, or master’s degree in engineering or technology, preferably electrical & electronic engineering, information technology, computer science or similar education
• At least five years of experience in systems engineering, systems architecture, and hands-on experience in software development
• Very good knowledge of Web of Things (WoT) and semantic data schemas and ontologies, e.g. Brick, Haystack
• Full-stack knowhow of system architecture and technologies from field devices to PC-based tooling, edge and cloud systems and cybersecurity
• Extensive experience in commonality and variability management in complex systems and software product line engineering, such as domain engineering, feature modeling and software factory methods
• Experience in establishing systems architecture in products and systems development based on agile and SAFe development processes and methods
• Strong skills in stakeholder management, cross-culture collaboration and leadership
• Preferably you bring domain knowledge in Building Automation, HVAC, Lighting, Shading
• Proficient communication and presentation abilities in English. German and any additional language is a plus Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard

Durch die Kombination der realen und digitalen Welten befähigen wir unsere Kunden, ihre Dekarbonisierungsziele zu erreichen, ihre Betriebskosten zu senken und erstklassige Insassenerlebnisse für ihre Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Es geht nicht nur darum, Gebäude zu verbessern – es geht darum, effiziente, sichere, anpassungsfähige und nachhaltige Umgebungen zu schaffen, die die Art und Weise, wie die Welt lebt und arbeitet, verbessern. Die digitale Transformation von Gebäuden ist ein sich schnell verändernder, dynamischer Sektor, und er braucht mehr als nur großartige Technologie - er braucht auch großartige Menschen. Wir wissen, dass ein Unternehmen nur dann gedeiht, wenn seine Mitarbeiter florieren, also haben wir bei Siemens unsere Mitarbeiter an die erste Stelle gesetzt. Innerhalb unseres Gebäudegeschäfts wird unser vielfältiges globales Team Sie während Ihrer Karriere unterstützen und Sie herausfordern, auf neue und aufregende Weise zu wachsen, während wir die Infrastruktur der Welt verändern. Unsere gemeinsame Reise könnte dich überall hinbringen ... wohin würdest du gerne gehen? Als Systems and Core Assets Product Line Architect sind Sie für die Definition und Weiterentwicklung der Systemarchitektur für Gebäudeautomationssysteme verantwortlich. Sie werden die technische Vision schärfen, die Strategie für die Entwicklung gemeinsamer wiederverwendbarer Kernanlagen definieren und neue Technologien bewerten, um menschenzentrierte autonome Gebäude zu realisieren. Diese Rolle erfordert eine operative Führung, um hochwertige und wiederverwendbare Kernanlagen zu liefern. Sie arbeiten mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern wie Architekten, Produktmanagern, Projektmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen. Gerne stellen wir Ihnen unser spannendes Umfeld vor! Standort: Diese Rolle wird in Zug/Schweiz angesiedelt sein. Bitte beachten Sie, dass qualifizierte Bewerber in der Schweiz rechtlich berechtigt sein müssen, eine Arbeitserlaubnis zu erhalten. Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Definieren Sie die architektonische Start- und Landebahn, die Technologie-Roadmap und die Cybersicherheit und gewährleisten Sie die Gesamtbetriebskosten und die architektonische Konsistenz zwischen verschiedenen Produkten und verschiedenen F & E-Standorten
• Verantwortlich für die Identifizierung, Gestaltung, Pflege und Steuerung der Strategie und Implementierung von Core Assets, die von mehreren Produkt- und Systemangeboten wiederverwendet werden sollen

Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. As a Data Scientist, you will turn data, domain knowledge, and advanced AI methods into scalable, measurable, and trustworthy capabilities for SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). This is a high-impact role for a hands-on AI and data professional who wants to work at the center of a new team shaping how Generative AI, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making are applied across product development. In this role, you will contribute to design, prototype, validate, and operationalize AI-enabled solutions across software and firmware development lifecycles. You will bring strong analytical, statistical, and machine learning expertise to transform complex engineering data into insights, models, evaluation frameworks, and reusable data products. Working at the intersection of data science, AI engineering and product development, you will help ensure that AI initiatives are not only innovative, but also robust, explainable, valuable for engineering teams, secure and compliant. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of AI Data Scientist – your team is looking forward to meeting you! Your new responsibilities
• Design, develop, and validate machine learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics solutions that support product development, engineering productivity, quality improvement, cybersecurity, and decision-making across our SDLC
• Support the development of AI-assisted and agentic capabilities across requirements engineering, architecture analysis, coding, testing, security, vulnerability management, release readiness, and lifecycle management by applying data science methods to real engineering workflows
• Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and evaluation pipelines for LLM-based applications, RAG solutions, agentic workflows, classification models, prediction models, and AI-assisted engineering use cases, ensuring that feasibility, quality, and measurable value are assessed early and continuously
• Identify, acquire, clean, structure, and enrich data from engineering toolchains, repositories, documentation, requirements, test systems, vulnerability sources, and enterprise platforms to make it usable for AI and analytics solutions
• Define and implement evaluation approaches, performance metrics, validation methods, monitoring concepts, and quality criteria for AI models and GenAI applications, with attention to explainability, robustness, bias, privacy, security, and responsible AI principles
• Create reusable datasets, embeddings, feature stores, notebooks, pipelines, model evaluation assets, and documentation that enable scalable adoption and repeatable delivery of AI capabilities across teams and use cases
• Explore emerging AI, machine learning, data science, and GenAI techniques, frameworks, and tools, and assess their applicability for SI B PRO use cases in collaboration with the AI Core team and engineering stakeholders Your talents and experience
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, AI engineering, applied analytics, or related technical roles, ideally in engineering or industrial technology environments
• Good understanding of data engineering foundations, including data pipelines, APIs, databases, versioning, data quality, metadata, and reproducible experimentation
• Strong practical experience with programming languages and common data science and machine learning ecosystems, including data processing, model development, experimentation, evaluation, and visualization
• Understanding of software and firmware development lifecycles, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity considerations, and how AI can support engineering workflows in a secure and scalable way
• Hands-on exposure to Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation of GenAI outputs, and ideally agentic AI workflows and experience with machine learning methods
• Ability to work with complex and heterogeneous engineering data, such as requirements, source code metadata, test results, logs, documentation, vulnerability information, and lifecycle artifacts
• Awareness of AI governance, privacy, responsible AI, model risk, explainability, and regulatory expectations relevant to enterprise AI adoption
• Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain data science concepts to architects, product owners, engineers, cybersecurity experts, and business stakeholders
• Fluent in English Employee benefits

Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Mission: As an AI Product Owner, you will play a pivotal, high-impact role within our central Technology & Innovation department, focusing on the strategic implementation and widespread adoption of Generative AI across SI Buildings Product (SI B PRO). This isn't just about customer-facing AI; it's also about empowering our internal processes and product development teams by turning AI opportunities into scalable, valuable, and user-centric capabilities. You will be instrumental in making AI technology accessible and driving its integration for the benefit of both our internal operations and, ultimately, our customer-facing products. In this role, you will translate business needs, engineering challenges, and emerging AI possibilities into clear product outcomes, prioritized backlogs, and measurable value, leading the definition and rollout of AI-enabled capabilities across the entire product development lifecycle. Working at the intersection of product ownership, engineering transformation, cybersecurity, and AI enablement, you will help shape the next generation of AI-powered ways of working. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of AI Product Owner – your team is looking forward to meeting you! Your new responsibilities
• AI Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and evolve the AI product vision, value proposition, and delivery roadmap across SI B PRO, aligning AI initiatives with business priorities, product roadmaps, engineering needs, and responsible AI principles
• Product Ownership & Value Delivery: Own and prioritize the AI product backlog, translate strategic objectives into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and ensure that delivered capabilities create measurable value for engineering teams and business stakeholders
• User Needs, Adoption & Change Enablement: Drive structured change management for AI-enabled ways of working across the software and firmware development lifecycle, ensuring that process adaptations, role impacts, training needs, communication, and adoption measures are clearly defined and embedded with development teams
• AI Solution Shaping & Functional Requirements: Translate complex AI opportunities into clear product requirements, workflows, user journeys, and MVP definitions, ensuring that technical solution concepts are turned into usable, scalable, and outcome-oriented capabilities
• Governance, Security & Compliance: Ensure AI products are developed and operated with appropriate guardrails for security, privacy, responsible AI, measurability, auditability, and regulatory alignment across enterprise and product development environments
• Platform, Toolchain & Ecosystem Integration: Drive product requirements for integration of GenAI capabilities with engineering toolchains, cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and product development environments to enable scalable and interoperable implementation
• Innovation & Technology Evaluation: Monitor emerging GenAI trends, platforms, models, and vendors, and translate relevant innovation into product opportunities, business cases, roadmap decisions, and adoption recommendations for SI B PRO Your talents and experience

• Several years of experience in product ownership, product management, agile delivery, digital transformation, AI/ML, or software-driven technology environments, including exposure to Generative AI solutions
• Experience defining product visions, roadmaps, business value, user stories, acceptance criteria, MVPs, and measurable outcomes for complex digital or AI-enabled products
• Strong understanding of software and firmware development lifecycles, DevSecOps practices, and how AI can support engineering workflows in a scalable, secure, and well-governed way
• Good understanding of AI governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory landscapes relevant to enterprise AI adoption
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and prioritization skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into practical business and engineering outcomes
